title: Borrower Copy of the Appraisal Order Report: Delivery Timing
content:
Under the ECOA valuations rule the borrower receives a free copy of every appraisal and written valuation on the file; for the Appraisal Order this covers every report type, whose copy is free.

## Delivery after completion

**Clause.** The borrower's copy of the report must be delivered no later than the end of the delivery period that starts on the date the report was completed. The period is the report type's number of business days for delivery after completion. Count business days forward from the completed date, which is day zero; delivery on the last business day of the period is on time. A business day is Monday through Friday excluding the US federal public holidays observed by the Federal Reserve Banks; Saturdays, Sundays and those holidays are skipped when counting.

The clock starts from the completed date on Larkspur's record of the Appraisal Order being delivered, not from a date the borrower states.

## Delivery before consummation

Independently, the copy must reach the borrower at least the report type's number of business days before consummation, unless the borrower signed a timing waiver at least that many business days before consummation, in which case delivery at or before consummation suffices.

## Revised reports

A revised report after a reconsideration of value is delivered under the same rule from its own decision date.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical, delivery period of 3 business days, no federal holiday in the week)

| Completed date (day zero) | Day 1 | Day 2 | Day 3 (last day) | Copy delivered on | On time? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Monday | Tuesday | Wednesday | Thursday | Thursday | Yes — the last business day of the period |
| Monday | Tuesday | Wednesday | Thursday | Friday | No — after the period ended |
| Thursday | Friday | Monday | Tuesday | Tuesday | Yes — Saturday and Sunday are skipped |

*Consummation, hypothetical:* with no signed timing waiver, a copy that reaches the borrower only one business day before consummation does not meet the before-consummation requirement of 3 business days; with a timing waiver signed at least 3 business days before consummation, delivery at consummation suffices.
